errors.evidence: The description states the black line ends at a value of 'a little over 700', but the plot shows this line ending at approximately 650, which is clearly below the 700 mark on the left y-axis.

The description states the blue line ends at a value of 'approximately 650'. However, the plot shows this line ending at a value just above 600, which is also the approximate final value of the black line that the description overestimates.
The description states the purple line ends at 'just under 8,000' ('knapp 8.000'). The line in the plot appears to end exactly on the 8,000 mark on the right y-axis, not below it.
